items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: Kent's band... And the song that they were playing sounded the same like the way we played.

ctx.x: What about coming into London? I wanted to ask you what happened after, when you arrived in the train station in London.

Oh that's what I was speaking about. Kent's band, he had about a twenty piece brass band or something like that. And the song that they were playing sounded the same like the way we played. And they had people on top of the sheds and so forth. And I understood that a couple of them got away to, been caved in.
Well they had some people there. They did have some people. She said hey. Go ahead. I just want to know about that, that came in.
